Make high-quality open models a productive tool that more people can afford.

Why inference

Open models are now good enough for most real work: coding, search, analysis, agents. What stands between them and everyday use is the cost and reliability of serving them. A model that is cheap to download can still be expensive to run, slow to answer, or subtly wrong in production.

At their core, GPUs are sand. The value comes from what the system around them does: how chips talk to each other, how memory holds a long context, how a scheduler keeps every user's stream fast, how an agent's tool call arrives intact. That is where we work.

What we build

Engineering. We optimize the inference path end to end: GPU communication without NVLink, million-token context, throughput at a usable per-user speed, KV-aware serving and agent correctness. We publish the methods and the numbers in our engineering notes.

Zenith Tokens. Our platform turns that work into a product: one OpenAI-compatible API for leading open models, priced so teams can actually use them.

How we work

Every change starts with a test. We measure the baseline before tuning, re-run and challenge our own conclusions, and keep the evidence so the next iteration starts further ahead. When a claim has limits, we say so next to the number.

What we value

Rigor

Numbers come with conditions. We claim what we measured, nothing more.

Openness

Open models, published methods, compatible APIs. Build with the ecosystem, not around it.

User value

Lower cost and faster answers that show up in our users' products.

Trust

Clear prices, visible status and a real person to talk to.
